# Funnels API — operations

7 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `funnels.create-redirect` — **Create Redirect** — `POST /funnels/lookup/redirect` (write, location)
  The "Create Redirect" API Allows adding a new url redirect to the system.
- `funnels.delete-redirect-by-id` — **Delete Redirect By Id** — `DELETE /funnels/lookup/redirect/{id}` (write, location)
  The "Delete Redirect By Id" API Allows deletion of a URL redirect from the system using its unique identifier.
- `funnels.fetch-redirects-list` — **Fetch List of Redirects** — `GET /funnels/lookup/redirect/list` (read, location)
  Retrieves a list of all URL redirects based on the given query parameters.
- `funnels.get-funnels` — **Fetch List of Funnels** — `GET /funnels/funnel/list` (read, location)
  Retrieves a list of all funnels based on the given query parameters.
- `funnels.get-pages-by-funnel-id` — **Fetch list of funnel pages** — `GET /funnels/page` (read, location)
  Retrieves a list of all funnel pages based on the given query parameters.
- `funnels.get-pages-count-by-funnel-id` — **Fetch count of funnel pages** — `GET /funnels/page/count` (read, location)
  Retrieves count of all funnel pages based on the given query parameters.
- `funnels.update-redirect-by-id` — **Update Redirect By Id** — `PATCH /funnels/lookup/redirect/{id}` (write, location)
  The "Update Redirect By Id" API Allows updating an existing URL redirect in the system.
